name: Lazarus MedBrace Post-Surgical Compression Set
description:
Issued in pale clinical grey with soft amber sensor piping, this full-torso compression garment covers from mid-thigh to collarbone. Graduated compression panels target lymphatic drainage and surgical site stabilization. Each unit is thermally bonded to patient measurements at point of discharge — Lazarus Pharmacy's logo is heat-stamped above the left hip.

The fabric is smooth and slightly cool to the touch. Velcro-free magnetic closures run down the sternum and left side for post-op access. An amber light pulses slowly at the base of the sternum when wound-site sensors detect elevated inflammation.
functionality: Graduated compression for post-surgical lymphatic and circulatory support. Integrated wound-site sensors alert wearer and linked MedNet device to inflammation or infection flags. Magnetic closures allow medical access without full removal. Fits over most limb-chrome mounting hardware at shoulder or hip.
what_it_says: You've been cut open recently, and you're still standing.
worn_by: post-surgical patients — aug installation recovery, organ replacement, geneware procedures
Tier 2 workers who can't afford full recovery leave
anyone a week out from something serious
price_range: Φ140–Φ260 (partially subsidized under Lazarus MedCredit plans)
story_hooks: A character still wearing their Lazarus compression set six months post-op — the sensors keep logging, and Lazarus's data division owns that health record.
Someone is wearing a Lazarus set that isn't theirs — the sensor ID routes to a patient listed as deceased.
The amber inflammation warning has been solid red for three days; the character can't afford a follow-up appointment and is hoping it resolves itself.

physical_description.visual_profile: A clinical yet form-fitting full-torso compression garment that reads as medical-grade and distinctly corpo. The pale grey base creates a sterile, almost ghost-like silhouette, broken only by soft amber sensor piping that traces the torso and shoulders like circuitry. On a wearer, it appears sleek and utilitarian—neither fashion nor activewear, but explicitly therapeutic. The aesthetic sits firmly in Tier 1-2 corpo medical infrastructure.
physical_description.fit: Precision-fitted compression throughout. Snug against the torso and thighs without restriction; graduated compression panels taper from mid-thigh up through the chest. The fit is anatomically tailored to the individual wearer—no standard sizing after thermal bonding at discharge. Shoulders and collarbone remain unobstructed for mobility.
physical_description.primary_material: Medical-grade synth-composite with embedded sensor filaments; smooth, breathable, slightly cool to the touch. Thermally bonded to patient measurements.
physical_description.texture: Smooth, matte finish with a subtle grip texture on compression zones. Sensor piping adds thin, thread-like tactile variation along key lymphatic pathways. No padding—purely technical.
physical_description.color_scheme: Pale clinical grey as dominant color. Soft amber sensor piping traces symmetrical lines down the sides, across the chest, and along the shoulders. Amber indicator light at the sternum pulses when inflammation is detected.
physical_description.closures: Magnetic snap closures running down the sternum and left side for post-operative access and removal without stress on healing tissue. No velcro.
distinctive_features: Embedded wound-site sensors with amber indicator light at sternum base
Graduated compression panel zones targeting lymphatic drainage
Heat-stamped Lazarus Pharmacy Group logo above left hip
Thermally bonded to individual patient measurements
Magnetic sternum and side closures for surgical access
Soft ambient sensor piping visible as tonal amber lines
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 1-2 corpo luxury medical. This is prescribed medical hardware, not accessible to street tiers. Signals wealth, corpo employment, or corporate insurance coverage.
physical_description.cultural_context: Wearer is recently post-surgical, likely corpo-affiliated, and under active medical monitoring. Lazarus Pharmacy branding signals trust in corpo medical infrastructure. Not fashion—a status indicator of access to premium healthcare and corpo wellness.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine when issued; develops subtle wear at magnetic closure points and slight discoloration at pressure zones over weeks of wear. Sensor piping may fade slightly. Typically replaced at 6-8 week post-op mark.
